name: Historic Brookhaven, Ashford Park & Murphey Candler
type: Country Club Estates, 1940s–1960s Cottages & Luxury Custom Infill
tagline: Dual-Inspector CMI Precision for Brookhaven's Cottages, Custom Infill & Club Estates
era: 1920s – Present (Tudor/Brick Cottages, Mid-Century Ranches & $1.5M+ Custom Infill)
intro: Brookhaven is one of Metro Atlanta's sharpest architectural contrasts—pairing 1920s–1950s golf estates around Capital City Club and post-war brick cottages in Ashford Park and Lynwood Park directly beside multi-million-dollar modern custom infill homes and lakeside residences near Murphey Candler Park. Foresight's two-inspector CMI team evaluates both vintage DeKalb infrastructure and complex modern custom mechanicals in one coordinated visit.

keyDefects.title: Modern Custom Infill Flat-Roof Parapets, Scuppers & Kickout Flashing
keyDefects.description: High-end custom infill builds in Ashford Park and Drew Valley frequently combine low-slope roof membranes, parapet caps, and fiber-cement or stone transitions that leak when diverter flashing is omitted.

keyDefects.title: 1940s–1960s Cast-Iron/Clay Sewer Laterals Reused Under Renovated Homes
keyDefects.description: Many expanded cottages and infill teardowns tie shiny new interior PVC drains into the original 60-year-old clay or cast-iron lateral beneath mature Brookhaven oaks near the street tap.

keyDefects.title: Vented Crawlspace Moisture, Pier Settlement & Subfloor Joist Notching
keyDefects.description: Mid-century brick cottages around Ashford Park and Murphey Candler often show elevated crawlspace wood moisture, unstrapped structural beam shims, and plumber-notched floor joists.

keyDefects.title: Multi-Zone VRF/Heat Pump Balancing, Tankless Gas Sizing & DeKalb Radon
keyDefects.description: Large custom Brookhaven homes with dual tankless water heaters, 400A panels, resort pools, and finished basements over DeKalb granite require thermal load checks and 48-hour radon monitoring.

faqs.question: Why should buyers of renovated or custom infill homes in Ashford Park still order a sewer scope?
faqs.answer: Builders and flippers often replace plumbing inside the footprint while leaving the original clay or cast-iron lateral under the front yard untouched; an HD Sewer Scope Inspection (Call 678-480-2110 for Quote) verifies the pipe all the way to the street main.

faqs.question: Does the DeKalb County Low-Flow Plumbing Certificate apply inside incorporated Brookhaven?
faqs.answer: DeKalb County's pre-1993 low-flow transfer ordinance applies strictly to unincorporated DeKalb tax districts rather than incorporated Brookhaven, though nearby border parcels with Atlanta or Chamblee mailing addresses should always verify their county Tax District field (Call for Quote if needed).
